display.purpose: Hero headline only; capped by viewport height so the form stays in the first viewport.

statement.purpose: One large wine sentence on blush with inline photo pills.

headline.purpose: Section h2s; card-scale h2s step down to clamp(28px, 2.8vw, 40px).

button.purpose: Every pill action, in the display face.

label.purpose: Form labels (burgundy) and footer fact terms (rose); sentence case.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: State fades (160-260ms), draw-on-view strokes, nav underline.

motion.name: ease-spring
motion.purpose: Hover lifts, arrow nudges, tag tilt, pill widen, stage wake (700ms), success pop.

motion.name: draw-on-view
motion.purpose: Scribbles and ticks draw when scrolled into view; armed only when motion is allowed and the figure is off-screen.

motion.name: route-ink
motion.purpose: Journey route inks with scroll progress (pivot at 60% of viewport); stages wake as it arrives.

motion.name: idle-loop
motion.purpose: Gentle idle animation of illustrations: wiggle, bob, hop, turn, rise, swing, sway, twinkle, fly.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: durations 0.01ms; figures drawn; route --progress 1; all stages awake; plane at offset-distance 82%

components.css: .ds-stage { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px; font-family: var(--font-body, 'Figtree Variable', system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-medallion { width: 150px; aspect-ratio: 1; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--blush, #f8e9ee); border: 2.5px solid var(--wine, #4a0e22); transform: scale(0.82); opacity: 0.55; transition: transform 700ms cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1), opacity 500ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), background 500ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-medallion svg { width: 74%; overflow: visible; } .ds-stage:hover .ds-medallion { transform: scale(1); opacity: 1; background: #fff; } .ds-stage:hover .ds-hop { animation: ds-hop 2.6s cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1) infinite; transform-origin: 74px 78px; } .ds-stage h3 { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-display, 'Bricolage Grotesque Variable', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 36px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.025em; color: var(--wine, #4a0e22); } .ds-meta { margin: 6px 0 0; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--burgundy, #7b1e3a); } @keyframes ds-hop { 0%, 60%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); } 30% { transform: translateY(-10px) rotate(-4deg); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-medallion { transform: none; opacity: 1; } .ds-stage:hover .ds-hop { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
BKB Global is a burgundy-and-white school world where a pen is always at work. Lines draw themselves under headlines, ticks draw themselves beside principles, and a dotted route inks itself down the page as a parent scrolls from Nursery to Class 12. Small flat illustrations of blocks, books, flasks, compasses, caps, a paper plane, an atom and a marigold flower live around real photographs of students. They idle gently and never perform. The illustrations make it lively, the heavy grotesque headlines and plain sentences make it serious, and the warm wine-and-blush palette keeps it from feeling either childish or corporate.

The page is airy on white, with blush bands and one full burgundy band for rhythm and a wine footer to close. Everything has an outline: photos, cards, the form, step numbers and every illustration share the same 2.5px wine stroke, so photography and drawing read as one material. Depth comes from outlines, tilt and overlap, never from shadows.

The system turns down the photo-hero-plus-three-cards template and the earlier rejected two-ink textbook look. Animation follows PRODUCT.md's principle that motion serves understanding: it guides the eye along the journey and never holds back information. With reduced motion everything is fully drawn and still.
keyCharacteristics: Burgundy and white as the school colours, with wine outlines, blush and rose panels, and marigold kept for highlights.
Bricolage Grotesque at 800 for headlines and Figtree for reading.
2.5px wine outlines on every frame, card and illustration, and 28px-rounded photo frames.
Flat illustrations with round caps that draw on view and idle gently.
Pill-shaped actions, pill tags and round step numbers.
No shadows. Depth comes from outline, tilt, tape and overlap.
Unconfirmed facts appear in cream placeholder highlights and stock photos are labelled.

rules.name: The Marigold Spark Rule
rules.body: Use marigold only as a stroke, a fill inside an illustration, or a highlight a few pixels wide: underline scribbles, ticks, focus rings, nav underlines, tape and the skip link. Never use it for a panel, a section band, a button face or text.

rules.name: The Wine Outline Rule
rules.body: Wine is the only outline colour on light grounds. Every new figure, frame or card on white or blush gets a wine stroke, so drawings and photos belong to the same world.

rules.name: The Heavy Head Rule
rules.body: Set headings in Bricolage at 700 to 800 with negative tracking and text-wrap: balance. Body and labels are always Figtree.

rules.name: The Sentence-Case Rule
rules.body: No text is uppercased anywhere in the system. Labels stay small, bold and in sentence case.

rules.name: The Paper, Not Plastic Rule
rules.body: Use no box-shadow or drop shadow anywhere. If an element needs lift, give it an outline, a tilt, tape or an overlap.

rules.name: The Three Weights Rule
rules.body: Borders come in three weights: 2.5px wine for frames and figures, 2px for interactive controls, and 1.5px for dividers.

dos: Do outline every photo frame, card, medallion and illustration shape in 2.5px wine.
Do round photo frames and cards at 28px and shape every action, tag and choice as a 999px pill.
Do draw illustrations as flat shapes in burgundy, rose, blush, marigold and white, with round caps and joins.
Do let lines draw on view (1.1s ease-out) and let figures idle gently. Use spring easing for hover.
Do render everything fully drawn and still under prefers-reduced-motion.
Do set headings in Bricolage Grotesque at 700 to 800 with negative tracking, and body text in Figtree at 18px/1.6.
Do show unconfirmed facts in the cream placeholder highlight and label every stock photo.
Do use a 3px marigold outline for every focus state.
donts: Don't use box-shadow or drop shadows. Depth comes from outline, tilt, tape and overlap.
Don't use marigold for a panel, band, button face or text.
Don't add gradients, textures or detailed rendering to illustrations.
Don't uppercase labels or put small labels above headings.
Don't set body or label text in Bricolage, or headings in Figtree.
Don't present stock photos or placeholder facts as real school evidence.
